Hi Alyssa / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: Harbor Health is evaluating an inference platform to reduce per-token costs for batch inference and to add a dedicated deployment option for PHI-sensitive workloads. You mentioned two success criteria: (1) sub-200ms p95 for short chat responses and (2) auditable request logs and KMS integration for compliance.

Next step: we recommend a focused 30-minute technical briefing with one of our solutions engineers and the person who will own platform evaluation on your side (infra/devops/security). That will help us tailor the demo to the specific constraints you called out. Can you confirm who should join from Harbor for the technical deep dive?

Proposed 2–3 compact windows (PST):
- Tue May 25 — 10:00–10:30 AM PST
- Wed May 26 — 2:00–2:30 PM PST
- Thu May 27 — 11:00–11:30 AM PST

Suggested agenda (attached): 10m intro + 15m targeted demo (latency, routing, caching) + 5m next steps/commitments.

I attached a short discovery summary for your reference. If none of those slots work, tell me two windows that do and we’ll adjust.

Thanks —
Soojin
